targets.query:
from(bucket: "aw_metrics")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "aw_window_event" or r._measurement == "aw_afk_event") and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0) / 60.0 }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Свежесть данных")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "freshness_minutes")

import "date"
startBound = if v.timeRangeStart > date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) then date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) else v.timeRangeStart
from(bucket: "aw_metrics")
  |> range(start: startBound, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aw_window_event" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 60.0 }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Активность, мин")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "host"])
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> yield(name: "active_minutes")

import "date"
startBound = if v.timeRangeStart > date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) then date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) else v.timeRangeStart
from(bucket: "aw_metrics")
  |> range(start: startBound, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aw_afk_event" and r._field == "duration_s" and r.status == "afk")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 60.0 }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "AFK, мин")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "host"])
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> yield(name: "afk_minutes")

import "date"
startBound = if v.timeRangeStart > date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) then date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) else v.timeRangeStart
from(bucket: "aw_metrics")
  |> range(start: startBound, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aw_window_event" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with category_view: if r.category == "erp_1c" then "1С-Бухгалтерия" else if r.category == "file_manager" then "Файловый менеджер" else if r.category == "terminal_shell" then "Терминальная оболочка" else if r.category == "browser" then "Интернет-браузер" else if r.category == "office_docs" then "Офисные документы" else if r.category == "remote_admin" then "Удаленное администрирование" else if r.category == "development" then "Разработка и программирование" else if r.category == "communication" then "Средства связи" else if r.category == "database" then "Работа с базами данных" else if r.category == "monitoring" then "Мониторинг и диагностика" else if r.category == "virtualization" then "Виртуализация" else if r.category == "system" or r.category == "misc_user" or r.category == "other" or r.category == "" then "Системные приложения" else r.category }))
  |> group(columns: ["category_view"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 3600.0 }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Часы")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field", "category_view"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> yield(name: "categories_hours")

import "date"
startBound = if v.timeRangeStart > date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) then date.sub(d: 2h, from: now()) else v.timeRangeStart
from(bucket: "aw_metrics")
  |> range(start: startBound, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aw_window_event" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 3600.0 }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Активное время")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "total_active_hours")
